subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should the iOS phone Control tab move to this card-forward Chat/Talk layout, or stay aligned with the merged native-list iOS direction?
rationale: The change is visual product direction for a default iOS tab, overlaps a newer merged native redesign, and cannot be resolved by code correctness alone.

options.title: Pause for iOS design direction
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until a maintainer chooses the Control tab direction and the contributor rebases with visual proof.

options.title: Sponsor the card redesign
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase over current main, use branded typography, preserve current navigation behavior, and provide before/after simulator proof for the card-forward layout.

options.title: Close in favor of native lists
options.body: If maintainers prefer the current native SwiftUI direction, close this PR and the paired issue with that product decision rather than leaving the stale branch open.

recommendation.title: Pause for iOS design direction
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until a maintainer chooses the Control tab direction and the contributor rebases with visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS visual hierarchy work and the merged native redesign overlap this exact product/design choice.
